title: .NET Backend Developer
description:
Join our platform team building cloud services on Azure.

What you'll need:
- 4+ years of experience with C# and .NET (ASP.NET Core Web API).
- Entity Framework Core and SQL Server, including query tuning in T-SQL.
- Messaging with Azure Service Bus or RabbitMQ.
- Unit testing with xUnit; clean, SOLID code.

Nice to have:
- Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience with CQRS and Domain-Driven Design is a plus.
- Azure DevOps pipelines.
